title: IoT rule to AWS Lambda
description: Invoke a Lambda function from an IoT rule

introBox.headline: How it works
text: When an IoT event is sent to an IoT topic, a Lambda function is invoked. This pattern configures a Lambda function to poll this event. The function is invoked with a payload containing the contents of the message event.
